scope: Read-only requirements and current-evidence assessment; not formal red team, clinical review, or participant study.
recommendation: Conduct a real formative intended-user session with existing raw/assisted incident packets and independent assessment of the resulting reports. Do not substitute more model runs or validation packaging for participant outcomes.

evidence.finding: Feasibility pilot precedes held-out study; pilot cases cannot become held-out.
Comparator eligibility remains limited; unavailable alternatives are not failed competitors.
Independent EM and statistical review remains required; model consensus cannot substitute.
Existing workflow can collect all assigned incident reports and raw responses; timing is only uncollected or self-reported.
Separate report-validity judgments, pending reviewers and disagreement are retained, with self-reported reviewer independence.
Demonstration answers are scripted, with no actual user judgments, measured time, browser usability evidence or superiority result.
Captured cohort supplies 16 attempts, 15 stored notes, two actual readbacks and one execution failure; clinical/safety criteria unassessed.

work_executable_now: Use existing captured failures for explicit formative assignments; preserve every case and failure.
Perform browser/formative usability checks without claiming clinical or quantitative comparative benefit.
Repair documented semantic rubric false passes in separately versioned contracts; preserve original results.
external_dependencies: Actual intended users and independent reviewers; no fabricated participant identities or labels.
Eligible named comparator and common workflow.
Fresh held-out families, ratified endpoint/margins, external registration and appropriate analysis before confirmatory outcomes.
nonblocking_limits: Exposed cases are unsuitable for held-out claims but useful for formative sessions.
Uninstrumented timing blocks the proposed active-time endpoint, not qualitative feasibility.
Lack of a private competitor interface blocks claims about that competitor, not all useful local development.
Known SCJ-012-C02 and IR-001-C03 semantic mismatches block stronger catalog validity, not the separate reconciliation incident pilot.
